entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Roslyn does not take ‘global.json’ into account when opening a project that is part of a solution #82631
  • `global` keyword is offered after `global::` in attributes #82630
  • Inconsistent IL optimization in Release mode on Linux (identical if/else branches occasionally not optimized) #82628
    Backlog

Closed

  • F# inlay hints do not work with Alt-F1 momentary toggle #82614

PullRequests

Created

  • csproj-in-cone check (take 2) #82633
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Improve classification of file-based app directives #82627
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Add completion provider for `#:include` directives #82625
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix another RuntimeAsync NRE with hoisted methods #82624
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #82623
    Area-Infrastructure

Merged

  • Disallow `ref` modifier for a union declaration #82632
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Add IFSharpInlineHintsService2 for displayAllOverride support #82629
    Area-IDE, Community, Next
  • Report errors for union members that are not permitted #82626
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Check language version for union matching and conversions #82617
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #82622
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Run the Linux Single Machine CI with the Spanish locale. #82450
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Add a document outlining RoslynAnalyzer acquisition #82578
    Next

    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode

    Area-Analyzers, Community
  • Don't log named pipe connection failures as errors in BuildServerConnection #82609
  • Fix false positive "infinite chain of calls" error in collection expressions when parameterless constructor exists alongside params constructor #82591
    Area-IDE
  • Update AnalyzerConfig.cs s_propertyMatcherPattern regex key #82585
    Area-Compilers, Community, VSCode
  • Update insert.yml to use roslyn-tools for insertions #82615
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Reduce allocations during source text diffing #82462
    Area-IDE
  • Extension indexers: indexing with implicit indexers #82453
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Fix/76886 await nullable value type #82146
